metadata.notes: The recipe ROADMAP.md's capability test named as blocked, now run end-to-end: PEEL/CUT/FRY the potato (low heat, long duration — soft-fried, deliberately not browned, real technique); CRACK/BEAT/SALT the egg; COMBINE merges the two fried-potato and beaten-egg instances into ONE new tortilla_mixture instance (both consumed — verify in the log: potato-1 and egg_cracked-3 are both gone from final inventory); FRY the mixture, FLIP it, FRY the other side. Onion-free (sin cebolla) — no onion entity exists in this vocabulary yet, and it's a legitimate traditional variant on its own, not a workaround.
metadata.instanceIdNote: targetInstanceId 'egg_cracked-3'/'tortilla_mixture-4' aren't in initialInventory — they're ids CRACK/COMBINE spawn at runtime (recipe-runner.ts's spawnCounter), matching the same convention salted-fried-potatoes.json already uses for potato_peel-1. validate.ts logs a NOTE for these, not a failure — see that script's own comment on why spawned ids can't be verified statically.
